subject.title: fix(agents): extend thinking error recovery to body, detail, and responseBody carriers

question: Should Anthropic thinking-recovery treat matching text in generic string carriers (`body`, `detail`, and `responseBody`) as sufficient to repair session replay state, beyond the merged ProviderHttpError `errorBody` contract?
rationale: The implementation is small, but the detector authorizes session-history repair and retry; the acceptable breadth of provider-wrapper shapes is a product and recovery-policy boundary rather than a mechanical test gap.

options.title: Accept the narrow string-carrier scope
options.body: Approve the three string-only carriers after a runtime proof shows one of them triggers one repaired retry and the original error is not surfaced.

options.title: Keep only the canonical carrier
options.body: Retain the merged `errorBody` behavior and close this follow-up if maintainers do not want generic wrapper fields to initiate session repair.

options.title: Define a stricter provider-error contract
options.body: Require an explicit provider-error type or classifier before accepting additional carrier fields, trading broader coverage for a narrower trigger surface.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow string-carrier scope
recommendation.body: Approve the three string-only carriers after a runtime proof shows one of them triggers one repaired retry and the original error is not surfaced.

likelyOwner.reason: The discussion explicitly routes the carrier-scope question to this reviewer, while the issue already records a maintainer-review requirement.
